verdict.rationale: Graphite provides multiple AI-driven insight features directly in-product: automatic AI code review that identifies issues and suggests fixes (graphite-docs-4, -18, -19), Graphite Chat that summarizes PR changes, explains code, diagnoses failing checks, and surfaces related context (graphite-docs-6, -7, -8, -15, -21), and Agents that generate changes/PRs from natural-language descriptions (graphite-docs-12, -22). These are well documented with clear opt-in privacy terms (graphite-supp-1). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the AI review/chat quality (community evidence is mixed, with some griping about the AI additions - graphite-comm-10, -13) and no runtime probe confirming actual insight output.
